{{Quote|Lord Trioculus, are you aware that there are others who claim to be the new ruler of the Empire? I have been to the planet Gargon. There, Grand Admiral Grunger says ''he'' is our new leader. And ''he'' has a fleet of thirty star destroyers!|A member of the Royal Guard, to [[Trioculus]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]|<ref name="The Glove of Darth Vader">''[[The Glove of Darth Vader]]''</ref>}}
'''Gargon''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalore sector]].

==History==
{{Quote|Oh, come on, Chewie. We've gotten into more heavily guarded places than that—''"<br />"''Frowh rahgh rahrahraff vrawgh gr.''"<br />"''Well, the spice vaults of Gargon, for one.|Han Solo and Chewbacca|<ref name="Return of the Jedi" />}}
The planet was dominated by [[Gangster/Legends|gangsters]], and much of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[phobium]] was mined there.<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> Gargon was a source of raw materials for the construction of the two [[Death Star/Legends|Death Stars]].<ref name="TEA" />

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] auctioned off his secrets for purchase to people that have obtained an invitation.<ref name="auction">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Investigation|Dangerous Auction}}</ref>

The world was a noted [[Spice/Legends|spice]] production site.<ref name="TEA" /> Sometime prior to joining the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] [[Heist on Gargon|broke into]] the [[spice vaults of Gargon]] and received double payment as a result of the successful theft of spice.<ref name="TCSWE" />

[[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Miltin Takel]] was from Gargon.<ref name="I66">{{InsiderCite|66|Who's Who: Imperial Grand Admirals}}</ref> Grand Admiral [[Josef Grunger]] aided Takel's second in command to patrol Gargon due to reports of albino-skinned marauders around [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. He betrayed the fellow Grand Admiral and took over the planet following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. Despite an unsuccessful attempt by Takel to oust him, Grunger continued to use the planet as his headquarters, until he was killed at the [[Battle of Tralus (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Tralus]] in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].<ref name="I66" />
